title: Prove a uniform dirty-return volume obstruction for two-image prefixes (no new κ)
body:
The original and phase-repaired two-image prefixes are invertible, but that does not make either a completed output with every arbitrary dirty helper returned. This package proves an exact tensor-width determinant obstruction to that interface, and classifies every fixed complex pair of nonzero mixing coefficients for these source permutations.

A fixed uniform linear word built from register mixing, tensor powers of fixed invertible base address matrices, and arbitrary unitary calls has affine normalized log determinant. Both retained prefixes violate it: at widths 1, 2 and 3, `D3 * D1^64 / D2^16 = 3^52 / 5^16`, not one. More unitary calls or independent unitary helper outputs cannot repair this completed contract. The theorem leaves clean scratch, nonunitary compensating outputs, nonuniform coefficients, nonlinear schemes and global continuations open; it does not exclude the full five-in-fourteen problem or improve κ. The actual two-input triangular port remains a positive case because the prefix is off diagonal.

Credit lee-phys/PR4688 for the original prefix and rank engine, Yiyang/PR4710 for its phase repair, Dugongue/PR4743 for the full-input triangular ports, and Jacob Alan Sussman/PR4628 with eumemic and Swapnil Jain for the small-unit framework. All source bytes and notices remain unchanged.

Validation on Python 3.12.3: isolated normal/optimized and registered package replays pass; five exact source inputs, source syntax, absolute phases, independent tensor-cycle and trace counts, separate Gaussian-rational determinants, affine and triangular positives, coefficient identities and semantic controls pass. Committed-byte/source-history and whitespace checks pass. No hook-rank suite, native supplier replay, selected cold replay, Lean build or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

Scientific base is canonical main b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15. Before publication, compatibility with refreshed main was checked: guidance/selection and all five consumed source bytes are unchanged; historical pins are retained. The OS assignment and changed complex-new-helper-inventory scope are in TASK.json. Live PR/discussion overlap and its limitations are recorded.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof explanation, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No independent human review claimed.
